_doc: SEED-LIFECYCLE-1 answers for second-tenant. The system is generated from the seed kernel (seedadmit --onboard) and deployed by deploy/deploy-seed.mjs after every platform deploy (doctrine/seed-deploys.json); read by foundation/seedlife.py.

health.how: the watchdog fetches the verify URL every pass; a failing reading reopens Q-SEED and the handoff closer rolls back

privacy.why: the seed holds no personal data: it runs with PUBLIC_HEALTH_ONLY=1, takes no visitor input and stores only its own ticks, items and metrics
